instructions: Nano Studio Cut is a video editor. These tools read and edit the project open in it. Every edit shows live in the editor, becomes part of its undo history and can be undone by the user. Times are seconds on the sequence timeline (with frame numbers at the sequence rate beside them); source_in and source_out are seconds of the source media. Edits snap to whole frames. Ids (clips c<n>, media m<n>, tracks V1/A1, markers, captions, effects e<n>) come from the read tools: call get_sequence before editing, and get_clip for one clip's details. sequence_id may be left out: the active sequence. A refused edit changes nothing. Read its message, then fix the arguments or tell the user why it cannot be done. Change only what the request asks for. Do not change project or sequence settings, other clips or anything else the user did not ask about, not even to make a refused edit work; suggest such a change in your answer instead. Keyboard and menu commands without a tool of their own run with run_action (list_actions lists them). Long jobs (automation, proxies, an export with wait) report progress and end when the user presses Stop. A call still running after a while (or one waiting for the user's answer in a dialog) answers {running: true, job, progress}: it has not failed and goes on running. Call wait_job with that job until it gives the tool's own result; never start the tool again, and do not tell the user it failed or timed out while it runs. Files: import_media brings in only files the user confirms in a dialog or that are in the project's folder; export_sequence, export_frame and export_captions ask the user first and write new files only; save_project writes the project's own file (and asks where when it has none). Nothing else reads or writes files, and nothing is downloaded unless the user agrees in Cut's setup dialog. Locked tracks are the user's: leave them alone.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Read the project
tools.description: The project's sequences (size, rate, length, clip count, which is active), its media count, bins, LUTs, settings, whether it was saved to a file and has unsaved changes, the playhead and the selection. Start here.

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.title: Read the timeline
tools.description: A sequence's tracks, clips (time on the timeline, source range, effects, links), transitions and caption tracks. from/to (seconds) keep the clips that overlap that range; long sequences are cut at max_clips.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

from.description: Only clips that end after this time (s).

to.description: Only clips that start before this time (s).

tools.name: get_clip
tools.title: Read a clip
tools.description: Everything about one clip: properties, keyframes (times on the timeline), effects with all their parameters, masks, text layers, clip markers.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: get_media
tools.title: Read the media
tools.description: The project's media: id, name, kind, length, picture size and rate, whether it has sound, how many clips use it, its bin, whether it has a proxy or its file is missing (offline). No file paths.

tools.name: get_markers
tools.title: Read the markers
tools.description: The sequence markers and the clip markers (times on the timeline).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: get_captions
tools.title: Read the captions
tools.description: Caption tracks and their items (id, start, end, text). track_id picks one track; from/to (s) keep the items in that range; max_items caps each track (default 300).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

max_items.description: At most this many items a track.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Read the transcript
tools.description: What is said in the sequence, from speech recognition already done in Cut: segments with start, end (s) and text. Empty when the speech was not recognised yet (the user runs Auto Captions or the Transcript panel).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: list_effects
tools.title: List the effects
tools.description: The video and audio effects and the transitions there are, with their parameters as "id: type min..max = default". kind and search narrow the list.

search.description: Part of a type, a name or a category.

tools.name: get_frame
tools.title: Look at a frame
tools.description: A PNG of the program monitor's picture at a time (the playhead when left out), with the shown caption track burned in, so you can see the edit.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: get_state
tools.title: Read the editor state
tools.description: The playhead, whether it plays, the selected clips, the sequence In/Out and the last steps of the undo history.

tools.name: place_clip
tools.title: Place a clip
tools.description: Puts media (or a nest of another sequence) on the timeline at a time. mode overwrite replaces what is there; insert pushes later clips. Video goes on video_track (default V1), sound on audio_track (default A1); null leaves that part out. source_in/source_out pick part of the media (s); a picture takes duration (s).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

nest_sequence_id.description: Instead of media: another sequence, placed as one nest clip.

at.description: Where it starts on the timeline (s).

video_track.description: Video track id, or null for none.

audio_track.description: Audio track id, or null for none.

tools.name: move_clips
tools.title: Move clips
tools.description: Moves clips along the timeline (to: the new start of the earliest one, or delta: seconds, negative earlier) and between tracks (track_delta: +1 one track up, -1 down). Linked and grouped clips move along unless linked is false. insert pushes clips at the destination instead of overwriting them.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

to.description: New start of the earliest clip (s).

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.title: Trim a clip
tools.description: Moves a clip's start or end edge (to: the new edge time, or delta: seconds). mode normal leaves a gap or fills one, ripple moves later clips with the edge, roll moves the neighbouring clip's edge too, stretch (Rate Stretch) changes the speed so the same source fills the new length. slip (delta s, no edge) shows a later (+) or earlier part of the source in place; slide (delta s, no edge) moves the clip while its neighbours trim. The result says where it stopped and why (source, neighbour, length, speed).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

edge.description: start or end (not for slip and slide).

delta.description: Seconds to move the edge (or slip, slide) by.

mode.description: normal (default), ripple, roll, stretch, slip or slide.

tools.name: razor
tools.title: Razor
tools.description: Cuts clips in two at a time: on every unlocked track, or only on track_ids, or only clip_ids (with their linked clips).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: delete_clips
tools.title: Delete clips
tools.description: Removes clips (with their linked and grouped clips unless linked is false). ripple closes the gaps they leave on their tracks and the sync-locked ones.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: delete_range
tools.title: Delete a time range
tools.description: Removes from..to (s) on every unlocked track, or on track_ids. ripple (default true) pulls later material earlier (Premiere's Extract: "cut the first 3 seconds"); ripple false leaves a gap (Lift).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: link_clips
tools.title: Link clips
tools.description: link joins clips so they move, trim and get deleted together; unlink parts them; group and ungroup do the same for a group (clips that move and delete together).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_clip
tools.title: Change a clip
tools.description: Changes a clip's settings. Video clips: opacity (%), position ([x, y] px from the center), scale (% or [w %, h %]), rotation (deg), anchor, crop ([top, right, bottom, left] %), interpolation (sample or blend: Time Interpolation), color (a color matte's #rrggbb). Audio clips: volume (dB, 0 unchanged), pan (-100..100), fade_in, fade_out (s). Both: name, enabled, role (Essential Sound's audio type: dialogue, music, effects, ambience or null), label (a color label or null). The value is the clip's static value; set_keyframes animates it.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

label.description: violet, iris, caribbean, lavender, cerulean, forest, rose, mango or null.

linked.description: Its linked clips too, where it applies (default true).

tools.name: set_speed
tools.title: Change the speed
tools.description: Speed/Duration: a clip's constant speed in % (100 normal, 50 slow motion, 200 twice as fast), or the duration (s) that the same source should fill, and reverse. ripple (default true) moves later clips with the new length. Linked clips change too unless linked is false.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

duration.description: Instead of speed: the new length (s).

tools.name: set_time_remap
tools.title: Time remapping
tools.description: Time Remapping of a video clip: its speed changes along it, replacing any remapping it has. segments in order: {speed: % (1 to 10000), until: timeline time (s) where it ends, as the clip plays now; ramp: seconds of speed transition into the next speed segment}, {hold: seconds of a freeze frame} or {reverse: seconds it plays backward, then forward again for as long}. A hold or reverse goes between two speed segments; the last segment is a speed with no until. Each speed segment keeps its source frames, so the clip gets longer or shorter (up to the next clip). off: true goes back to one constant speed.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

until.description: Timeline time (s) where this speed segment ends.

ramp.description: Seconds of transition into the next speed (0.04..60).

reverse.description: Backward this long (s), then forward again.

tools.name: set_keyframes
tools.title: Set keyframes
tools.description: Animates a property of a clip: the full list of keyframes (time on the timeline in s, inside the clip; value; ease linear, hold, easeIn, easeOut or easeInOut). An empty list removes the animation. property: a clip property (opacity, position, scale, rotation, anchor, crop, volume, pan), "effects.<effect id>.<parameter>" (video and audio effects), a mask's "masks.<mask id>.<path|feather|opacity|expansion>" (an effect's mask: "effects.<effect id>.masks.<mask id>.<field>"; a path value is {shape: ellipse|rectangle, x, y, width, height} in fractions 0..1, like add_mask) or a layer's "layers.<layer id>.<field>" (titles: opacity, position, reveal, size; graphics: number, [x, y], color fields).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: add_effect
tools.title: Add an effect
tools.description: Adds a video or audio effect (list_effects) to a clip, with parameters that differ from the defaults. The effect's kind must match the clip's track. Returns the effect id.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

index.description: Its place in the clip's effect list (default last).

tools.name: set_effect
tools.title: Change an effect
tools.description: Turns an effect on or off, changes its parameters (null puts one back to its default) and moves it in the clip's effect order (index 0 is applied first).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

index.description: Its new place in the effect list.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.title: Remove an effect
tools.description: Removes an effect from a clip, with its keyframes and masks.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_color
tools.title: Lumetri color
tools.description: Lumetri Color of a video clip, every section (its Lumetri Color, added when it has none). Basic: temperature, tint, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, vibrance (-100..100), exposure (-4..4 stops), saturation (0..200 %). Creative: lut (a LUT id from get_project, or "" for none), lut_intensity (%). curves: master, red, green, blue as flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] lists 0..1 ([0, 0, 1, 1] is unchanged). hsl (HSL Secondary): the range (hue 0..360, hue_range and hue_soft in degrees; sat_low, sat_high, sat_soft, lum_low, lum_high, lum_soft %), its correction (temperature, tint, contrast, saturation %, hue_shift -180..180) and show_mask.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

lut.description: A LUT id of the project, or "".

show_mask.description: Show the range as a mask.

tools.name: add_transition
tools.title: Add a transition
tools.description: Puts a transition on an edit point of a track (where two clips meet, or a clip's start or end). type from list_effects (default: a cross dissolve, or a crossfade on audio); duration (s) defaults to the project's; align center, start or end.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: remove_transition
tools.title: Remove a transition
tools.description: Removes a transition (ids from get_sequence).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: add_text
tools.title: Add a title
tools.description: Adds a text clip (a title) at a time for duration seconds (default the project's still length), on track or else on the lowest free video track above the clips there (a new track when none is free).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

size.description: Font size in px of a 1080-line picture.

position.description: [x, y] px from the center (y > 0 is lower).

box.description: A background box color like #00000099, or null for none.

shadow.description: A drop shadow {color, blur, x, y}, or null.

tools.name: set_text
tools.title: Change a title
tools.description: Changes a text clip: the text and look of its first layer (or layer_id); add_layer: true adds a new layer with these settings instead; remove_layer removes one. animation puts a motion preset on the layer as keyframes: fade, rise or typewriter, in (at the start, default) or out (at the end).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

size.description: Font size in px of a 1080-line picture.

position.description: [x, y] px from the center (y > 0 is lower).

box.description: A background box color like #00000099, or null for none.

shadow.description: A drop shadow {color, blur, x, y}, or null.

tools.name: add_captions
tools.title: Add captions
tools.description: Adds caption items to a caption track (track_id), or makes a new caption track (name, lang) with them. Captions are subtitles shown over the picture, not title clips.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

lang.description: A new track's language code (ko, en...).

tools.name: set_caption
tools.title: Change a caption
tools.description: Changes one caption's text or times.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: remove_captions
tools.title: Remove captions
tools.description: Removes captions by id, or the whole caption track (whole_track: true).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

whole_track.description: Remove the track and all its captions.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.title: Add a marker
tools.description: Adds a sequence marker at a time, or a clip marker (clip_id). kind comment (default), chapter (YouTube chapters) or beat; color one of green, red, purple, orange, yellow, white, blue, cyan.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_marker
tools.title: Change a marker
tools.description: Changes a marker's time, name, kind, color or note.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: remove_markers
tools.title: Remove markers
tools.description: Removes markers by id, or every sequence marker of a kind (comment, chapter, beat or all).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: add_mask
tools.title: Add a mask
tools.description: Adds a mask to a video clip's Opacity (the clip shows only inside it), or to one of its effects (effect_id: the effect applies only inside). shape ellipse or rectangle, centered at x, y with width and height, all fractions 0..1 of the clip's picture.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

effect_id.description: Mask this effect instead of the clip.

mode.description: add, subtract, intersect, difference or none.

tools.name: set_mask
tools.title: Change a mask
tools.description: Changes a mask's static feather, opacity, expansion, inverted or mode, or its shape (shape with x, y, width, height as in add_mask). set_keyframes animates masks.<mask id>.<path|feather|opacity|expansion>.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

effect_id.description: When the mask is an effect's.

shape.description: ellipse or rectangle: a new path.

mode.description: add, subtract, intersect, difference or none.

tools.name: remove_mask
tools.title: Remove a mask
tools.description: Removes a mask and its keyframes.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

effect_id.description: When the mask is an effect's.

tools.name: nest_clips
tools.title: Nest clips
tools.description: Moves clips (with their linked and grouped clips) into a new sequence and puts one nest clip of it in their place, as Premiere's Clip > Nest. Returns the new sequence and the nest clips.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_track
tools.title: Change a track
tools.description: Changes a track: name; video tracks visible; audio tracks mute, solo, volume (dB, -60..24) and pan (-100..100); sync_lock. Locking and unlocking stay the user's.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_sequence
tools.title: Change the sequence
tools.description: Sequence Settings and the master track: name, frame size (width, height px, even), fps (23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94 or 60; every time moves to the new frames), background color, master_gain (dB on the whole mix, -60..24: the Audio Track Mixer's master). active: true brings it to the front in the timeline (not an undo step).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: remove_silence
tools.title: Remove silence
tools.description: Measures the sound on this PC and ripple-deletes every stretch quieter than threshold (dB, default -40) that lasts longer than longer_than seconds, on the speech tracks (music, effects and ambience clips do not count).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: select_clips
tools.title: Select clips
tools.description: Selects clips on the timeline (an empty list clears the selection); add keeps the selection there was.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: seek
tools.title: Move the playhead
tools.description: Moves the playhead (and the picture in the program monitor) to a time.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: play
tools.title: Play
tools.description: Starts playback in the program monitor from the playhead.

tools.name: stop
tools.title: Stop
tools.description: Stops playback in the program monitor; the playhead stays where it is.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the last step of the editor's history (the user's steps before your turn stay).

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the step of the editor history that was undone last.

tools.name: export_sequence
tools.title: Export
tools.description: Exports the sequence to a new file in the project's folder with a preset (youtube-1080p, youtube-4k, shorts, 720p, audio-m4a) and optional overrides of the Export Settings: width, height (px, even), codec (h264 or hevc), bitrate (Mbps), bitrate_mode, key_seconds, audio_bitrate (128, 160 or 192 kbps), loudness (target LUFS, or null to leave it). The user is asked first and may say no; an existing file is never replaced. from/to export part of it; captions burn draws the shown caption track into the picture. It joins the export queue; wait: true waits until it is written, with progress (Stop cancels it).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

file_name.description: A file name without folders (the preset's extension is added).

tools.name: import_media
tools.title: Import media
tools.description: Brings media files (video, sound, pictures) into the project, or caption files (.srt, .vtt) as a caption track of the sequence. paths: absolute file paths the user named; files in the project's folder come in at once, others only after the user confirms them in a dialog that lists them. Without paths the Import dialog opens for the user to pick files (folder: true picks a folder, its subfolders becoming bins). bin_id puts the media in a bin. Network shares are refused.

folder.description: Let the user pick a folder.

tools.name: remove_media
tools.title: Remove media
tools.description: Removes media from the project (never from the disk): media_ids, or unused: true for every media no sequence uses (Remove Unused). Media that clips use are refused; delete those clips first.

tools.name: project_items
tools.title: Bins and names
tools.description: The Project panel's items: new_bin (name, parent bin_id), remove_bin (bin_id; its items go to its parent), rename (item_id of a media, bin or sequence, name), move (item_ids into bin_id, or to the top when bin_id is left out).

tools.name: add_sequence
tools.title: New sequence
tools.description: Makes a sequence: a preset (youtube-1080p30, youtube-4k30, shorts, square) or width, height (even px) and fps, or duplicate_of another sequence (Duplicate). It goes in bin_id if given, and becomes the active sequence unless active is false.

tools.name: remove_sequence
tools.title: Delete a sequence
tools.description: Deletes a sequence from the project, with the nest clips of it in other sequences. The project keeps one sequence at least.

sequence_id.description: The sequence.

tools.name: add_track
tools.title: Add a track
tools.description: Adds a video or audio track (on top of its kind, or at index among its kind, 0 the lowest), with a name.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

index.description: Its place among the tracks of its kind.

tools.name: remove_track
tools.title: Delete a track
tools.description: Deletes a track with its clips and transitions. Locked tracks are refused.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_transition
tools.title: Change a transition
tools.description: Changes a transition: its duration (s), align (center, start or end of the edit), type (another transition of its kind, list_effects) or params.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_caption_track
tools.title: Caption track settings
tools.description: Changes a caption track: name, lang, sync_lock, and its Caption Style (font, size, weight, color, background, position, margin, highlight of the spoken word with highlight_color and highlight_mode, speakers). shown: true makes it the track the program monitor draws and an export burns in (not an undo step).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

margin.description: % of the picture height from the edge.

speakers.description: off, color, name or both: how speaker labels show.

tools.name: add_color_matte
tools.title: Add a color matte
tools.description: Adds a color matte (a full-frame solid color clip) at a time for duration seconds (default the project's still length) on a video track (default the lowest free one above the clips there).

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: set_project_settings
tools.title: Project settings
tools.description: The project's settings: still_duration (s, new pictures and titles), transition_duration (s, new transitions), freeze_duration (s, Insert Frame Hold), fit (fit, fill or original: how new media of another size scale), speech_terms (the word list speech recognition is told of: names and terms, as written).

tools.name: save_project
tools.title: Save the project
tools.description: Saves the project to its file. A project that was never saved opens the Save As dialog, where the user picks the place (or cancels). Never writes anywhere else.

tools.name: export_frame
tools.title: Export a frame
tools.description: Saves the program monitor's picture at a time (default the playhead) as a new PNG in the project's folder (Export Frame). The user is asked first; an existing file is never replaced.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

file_name.description: A file name without folders (.png is added).

tools.name: export_captions
tools.title: Export captions
tools.description: Writes a caption track to a new .srt or .vtt file in the project's folder. The user is asked first; an existing file is never replaced.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

track_id.description: The caption track (default the shown one).

tools.name: export_queue
tools.title: Export queue
tools.description: The export queue: list (its jobs: id, file name, state, progress, error), cancel, retry or remove a job (job_id), clear_finished.

action.description: list (default), cancel, retry, remove or clear_finished.

tools.name: proxies
tools.title: Proxies
tools.description: Proxies (720p H.264 copies that play smoothly; exports always use the original): status of media_ids (or all video media), create them (waits with progress unless wait is false; Stop cancels the ones not done), or remove them (the media play their original again).

tools.name: create_shorts
tools.title: Create a shorts sequence
tools.description: Highlights to Shorts: a new 9:16 sequence (1080x1920) holding only the given ranges of this sequence, back to back, with the video scaled to fill (mode fill, default) or fit. Captions and markers in the ranges come along. Choose the ranges from get_transcript; the new sequence becomes the active one.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

ranges.description: The parts to keep, in any order.

tools.name: automation
tools.title: Automation
tools.description: Runs an Automation menu job on this PC as one undo step; it reports progress and ends on Stop. transcribe (speech recognition; get_transcript reads it), auto_captions (a caption track from it), remove_fillers (ripple-deletes filler words and long pauses), label_speakers, isolate_voice (the voice without music or noise), detect_scenes (markers or splits), detect_beats (beat markers of an audio clip), match_loudness (master gain for a LUFS target), match_clip_loudness (each clip's volume for it), auto_duck (music lowered under dialogue; set_clip role first), auto_color (white balance and exposure). A job that needs a model asks the user in Cut's setup dialog first; a no is a refusal.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

clip_ids.description: The clips (default: the selection, else every clip it fits, as the menu does).

from.description: With to: only this range of the timeline (s), as In/Out.

highlight.description: Light each word as it is spoken.

threshold.description: detect_scenes: % of change, 5..95 (default 35); auto_duck: speech louder than (dB, -90..-5).

time.description: The frame to analyze (s; default five frames across the clip).

tools.name: essential_sound
tools.title: Essential Sound
tools.description: Essential Sound's one-click repairs on audio clips (a video clip brings its linked audio): clarity (EQ and compressor for dialogue), reduce_hum_50 or reduce_hum_60 (mains hum), noise_gate, hard_limiter (-1 dB). Each adds its effects with the panel's settings, as one undo step; set_effect changes them after. The audio type is set_clip role; voice isolation, ducking and loudness are automation jobs.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

tools.name: speakers
tools.title: Speakers
tools.description: The speaker labels of the project (made by automation label_speakers): list them (id, name, color), or rename one (speaker_id, name; an empty name goes back to "Speaker n"). Names show in the Transcript panel and in captions that show speakers.

tools.name: add_graphic
tools.title: Add a graphic
tools.description: Adds a motion graphic clip drawn from layers (shapes, paths, text, groups, particles) on a transparent background, at a time for duration seconds. Pixels from the frame's center, y down; the first layer at the bottom. Animate with set_keyframes on "layers.<id>.<field>": trimEnd 0 to 100 draws a line on, value counts up a {value} text, scale [0, 0] to [100, 100] pops in. Check with get_frame.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

track.description: A video track (default: a free one).

items.description: A layer: {id, kind, ...fields}. By kind: rect size [w, h], radius; ellipse size; polygon points, radius; star points, radius, innerRadius; line from [x, y], to [x, y]; path d (SVG path data, no A arcs); text text ("{value}" shows value), font, fontSize, weight, italic, align, lineHeight, letterSpacing, value, decimals, reveal (0..1); group (others name it as parent); particles count, seed, emit (stream or burst), emitter [w, h], direction (degrees, 0 up), spread, speed (px/s), speedVariation, gravity [x, y] (px/s²), life (s), particleSize, particleSizeEnd, fill, fillEnd, opacityEnd, particleShape (circle or square), spin. Paint: fill ("#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or null), gradient ({type: linear or radial, from: [x, y], to: [x, y], stops: [[0, color], [1, color]]}), stroke, strokeWidth, cap, join, dash ([dash, gap]), trimStart, trimEnd, trimOffset (% of the outline). Every layer: name, parent (a group earlier in the list), visible, position [x, y], anchor [x, y] (pivot), scale [x %, y %], rotation (degrees), opacity (%), blend (normal, add, screen, multiply, overlay...), blur, shadowColor, shadowBlur, shadowOffset, repeatCount (copies), repeatOffset [x, y], repeatRotation, repeatScale [x %, y %] (per copy), repeatOpacity (last copy %).

tools.name: set_graphic
tools.title: Change a graphic
tools.description: Changes a graphic clip's layers as one undo step: layers replaces them all, or update (fields by id), add and remove.

sequence_id.description: The sequence; the active one when left out.

A layer, and after: the layer it goes above (default: on top).

tools.name: list_actions
tools.title: List the actions
tools.description: The editor's keyboard and menu actions that run_action runs (the ones with a tool of their own are not listed): id, what it does, what it needs, and view: true when it changes only what the user sees (no undo step). search narrows by words of the id or the text.

tools.name: run_action
tools.title: Run an action
tools.description: Runs one of the editor's keyboard or menu actions as the key would (list_actions gives the ids, what they do and need). time moves the playhead first and clip_ids selects clips first, for actions that work at the playhead or on the selection. Refused when what the action needs is missing; the result says what changed (the undo step, the selection, the playhead, In/Out).

shuttleBack.no: Shuttling is hands-on playback; play, stop and seek move the picture.

shuttleForward.no: Shuttling is hands-on playback; play, stop and seek move the picture.

fullscreen.no: Full-screen playback takes over the user's screen; the user starts it (Ctrl+`).

maximizeUnderCursor.no: It acts on the panel under the mouse pointer, which an AI does not hold; maximizePanel does the same for the focused panel.

saveAs.no: It writes the project to a new file at a place the user picks; save_project saves it to its own file (asking for a place only when it has none).

saveCopy.no: It writes a copy of the project to a place the user picks; the user does it.

restoreAutosave.no: It replaces the open project with an autosave the user picks from a list; the user does it.

open.no: It closes this project and opens another; that is the user's call.

newProject.no: It closes this project for a new one; that is the user's call.

keyHelp.no: A cheat sheet of keys for the person at the keyboard.

findMissing.no: Relinking picks files on disk in a dialog; the user does it (File > Find Missing Media…). get_media shows which media are offline.

aiPolish.no: The assistant is Claude: it reads the captions (get_captions) and fixes them itself (set_caption).

aiTranslate.no: The assistant is Claude: it reads the captions (get_captions) and writes a translated track itself (add_captions).

aiMetadata.no: The assistant is Claude: it writes titles and descriptions in its answer, from get_transcript; chapters are add_marker with kind chapter.

aiCommand.no: An edit command in plain words is what the assistant itself does.
